unit: ASST-010 S2: faithful lineage, protected feasibility and one discarded capacity geometry experiment

XYZWM.X: ASST-010 S2 reaches the 300-second timeout without a proposal after the 19-entry refresh.
XYZWM.Y: The fake acceptance omitted proposalRunId. Faithful lineage now recovers the real S1 witnesses; their joint replay is STALE at current durations. The nominal entry geometry cannot accommodate the required C01 closure; its repair decomposes shared capacity into prerequisites, chains, agendas and residual search.
XYZWM.Z: Only S1 is accepted in the full ASST gate; AcceptedException, rollback, redo and divergence remain NOT_REACHED.
XYZWM.W: Keep faithful proposalRunId persistence and recovery assertions, one service lineage regression and a reproducible complete positive witness. Revert the ordering-only gapped-entry geometry experiment after it exhausted 100000 branches with zero leaves/certificates.
XYZWM.M: Protected post-refresh canon FEASIBLE by full canonical validation; ASST still blocked at S2. Two fresh clean A2 runs retain 266/266 and identical material; all directed suites and required checks pass.

qualifications: Recorded control is the preceding restored run at the same product source and starting HEAD; it was not rerun in this turn.
Identical canonical input, scope, protections and first nine core fingerprints; differing fields are the two prior-witness fields.
Wall time and throughput are descriptive: host load and brief diagnostic work varied. No claimed performance gain from lineage correction.

qualifications: Negative restricted models establish only restricted infeasibility; global state is FEASIBLE through the complete positive canonical witness.

The external model keeps prior discrete assignments, rounds, chain layouts, transport memberships, operational meals, required secondary continuity and Main slot set; only the actually accepted task is fixed in the positive solve.
Nonaccepted Main/Vocal assignments may change. This positive witness does not prove those changes necessary in every valid continuation.
The first external candidate failed canonical audit and was excluded; the model was repaired before declaring FEASIBLE.
The positive artifact never enters production runs, scopes, protection or request/run/apply.

denseGeometryProof.qualification: Proof only for a dense contiguous geometry of ALL post-refresh entries. The protected canon itself is FEASIBLE.
denseGeometryProof.reason: Closure depends on its own entry, uses the same exclusive space and lasts 5 minutes; it cannot precede that entry, fit inside the dense 380-minute block, or finish after the block by participant deadline.

canonicalConflictReplay.qualification: Read-only canonical replay of recorded minimal conflicts. Not a production seed; gap experiment did not alter these authorities.

cause.hypothesis: The existing nominal pipeline already coordinates entries by matching. The repair later defers them and explores narrower prerequisite subsets; local C05/C08 conflicts are immediate, not late. Coupled producer decomposition is an observed limitation, but this iteration has not established a sufficient general repair architecture.
cause.nextAction: Build an ephemeral shared-capacity component producer that coordinates entries and closures together with revisable unaccepted Main/Vocal assignments, retains alternative continuations without caching ABSTAIN as rejection, and demonstrates a complete canonical leaf in the reduced fixture before another full ASST attempt.

equivalentRepairContexts.qualification: Provisional IN and all 19 entries removed exactly as the repair path, before deterministic IN recomposition; accepted task and canonical candidate meals retained.

discardedIntervention.reason: No reduction in the reduced complete fixture (52 branches in both); full ASST exhausted the ledger without reaching a residual invocation/complete leaf/certificate. 27 nominal cores collapsed to 2 materially identical repair contexts after stripping provisional IN/entries, causing 25 repetitions. Opening a geometry hole is insufficient when the downstream repair discards it.
